build.note: every artifact compiled natively on its own architecture - no emulation: arm64 on aarch64, amd64 on x86_64. The amd64 .deb is file-packed on the arm64 host (dpkg-deb is architecture-neutral file packing); its payload is the natively compiled amd64 tree, and it is installed and validated on native amd64.

coexistence.note: packaged under its own package name so it installs side by side with the other shipping lines ('montudb' / /opt/montudb/6.0 for 17.2, 'montudb-pg17.9' for 17.9, 'montudb-pg18.4' for 18.4). Operator ruling 2026-08-07: 17.10 does NOT supersede 17.9 - the two coexist, and all four bases ship in parallel. Distinct prefix, systemd unit, sbin helpers, data dir and doc dir; the 'montudb' system user is deliberately shared and created idempotently by every line.
coexistence.verified: all four runtime .deb packages installed together in one clean container - no file conflict, all four banners resolve

montu_optimizer.line: V6 MBBM (Multi-pass Bloom Bucket Merge) on top of V5 BloomHash, V4 Compose, Condense, OLAP/MRRV and RealCost
montu_optimizer.note: default-OFF; zero catalog change vs the 5.0 line
